slug: 2025-01-20 PID Appraisal Stage - Digital Zambia Acceleration Project (P505094)

facts.fact: The World Bank's project information document for the Digital Zambia Acceleration Project states that cross-border infrastructure between countries is missing in Zambia, hindering seamless digital trade; the document is dated 20 January 2025 and gives no earlier date.

note: The project has a sub-component 'Extending the backbone and regional network' (IDA US$20m, commercial US$10m) but the excerpt names no cross-border link or other country at its end.
